verdict.rationale: OpenTofu makes a first-party compatibility promise: its manifesto commits to being 'Backwards-compatible' so existing code keeps working for years, and the site positions it as a drop-in Terraform replacement. Community reports describe Terraform-to-OpenTofu migration as easy and note a release that kept Terraform compatibility. However, the evidence shows no release-to-release upgrade guides, versioning or semver policy, or deprecation documentation. Missing for 10: per-release upgrade or migration guides, a formal compatibility/versioning policy document, deprecation and breaking-change notices, independent corroboration of smooth upgrades between OpenTofu versions.
